headline: Decisions on three requests: 66 Hope St and 512 Cottage St variances, and a retail cannabis business at 92 East Ave.
summary: Three requests are up for decision. Two seek building changes at 66 Hope St and 512 Cottage St, and one seeks to open a retail cannabis business at 92 East Ave.
items: Belinda L. Phillippe requests a dimensional variance for 66 Hope St (Tax Assessors Plat 46 Lots 209, RM Residential Multi-family Zone) to build an addition to the existing structure not in compliance with the zoning ordinance. For decision.

Barbara and James Winters request a dimensional variance for 512 Cottage St (Tax Assessors Plat 10 Lots 136, RT Residential Two-family Zone) to build a 16ft by 30ft roof over an existing patio. Proposed lot coverage would be 40%, above the 30% maximum. For decision.

Gary Dantzler, applicant, and Houses for the Community LLC, owner, request a use variance for 92 East Ave (Tax Assessors Plat 53 Lots 580, RD3 Riverfront Mixed-Use Zone) to operate a retail cannabis business, which is not allowed in that zone. For decision.

addition to the existingstructure not in compliance with the zoning ordinance - FOR DECISON
Barbaraand James Winters, Applicant and Owner of the property at 512 Cottage St further identified as
TaxAssessors Plat 10 Lots 136, located in an “RT” Residential Two-family Zone, isrequesting a Dimensional
Variance under Sections 410-44 of the Pawtucket ZoningOrdinance. The applicant is proposing to construct
a 16ft by 30ft roof over anexisting patio that is not in conformance with the 30% lot coverage maximum.The
proposed lot coverage would be 40%.  - FOR DECISION.
GaryDantzler, Applicant and Housesfor the Community LLC, Owner of the property at 92 East Ave,
furtheridentified as Tax Assessors Plat 53 Lots 580, located in an “RD3” Riverfront Mixed-Use Zone, is
requesting a UseVariance under Sections 410-12.7(B) and 410.12(G) of the Pawtucket ZoningOrdinance.
The applicant is proposing to operate a retail cannabis business atthe property which is not allowed in a
Riverfront Mixed-Use Zone. - FOR DECISION
